CODE
2.3.2. 
Authorised inheritance agreement
If one of the spouses has one or more descendants from a relationship prior to their marriage or adopted prior to their marriage, or descendants of such descendants, they may conclude in their matrimonial agreement, even without reciprocity, a full or partial agreement relating to the rights that one may exercise in the succession of the other.
This agreement is without prejudice to the right of one of them to dispose, by will or inter vivos deed, in favour of the other.
Under no circumstances may it deprive the surviving spouse of the right of dwelling in the property which, on the date of the opening of the premature spouse's estate, was the main family dwelling, or of the non-transferable right of usufruct of the furnishings in the property, for a period of six months from the date of the opening of the premature spouse's estate.
Articles 4.244 to 4.253 apply to this agreement.
